svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Tray Rental & Ordering Process" id="w0fsnfWSdWBrE3Z7_GhS"> <mxGraphModel dx="2830" dy="1848" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#ffffff', 'primaryBorderColor': '#000000', 'primaryTextColor': '#000000', 'lineColor': '#000000', 'secondaryColor': '#ffffff', 'tertiaryColor': '#ffffff'}}}%%
stateDiagram-v2
 state \"Customer\" as Customer {
 [*] --> Select : Select seed, area, cycles & date
 Select --> AddCart : Add tray to cart
 AddCart --> ReviewCart : Review or update cart
 ReviewCart --> Checkout : Checkout & enter address
 Checkout --> SubmitOrder : Submit order
 SubmitOrder --> RiskAccept : Confirm biological risk acceptance
 RiskAccept --> PayRequest : Request payment QR
 PayRequest --> Transfer : Transfer payment via banking app
 CancelOrder --> [*]
 }

 state \"System\" as System {
 state check_radius <<choice>>
 state check_accept_radius <<choice>>
 state check_available <<choice>>
 state check_risk <<choice>>
 state check_webhook <<choice>>
 state check_planting_due <<choice>>

 ReviewCart --> Validate : Validate cart & farm area
 Validate --> CalculateDistance : Calculate delivery distance
 CalculateDistance --> check_radius : Within radius?

 check_radius --> check_available : [Yes]
 check_radius --> check_accept_radius : [No]

 check_accept_radius --> check_available : [Yes - Customer accepts]
 check_accept_radius --> CancelOrder : [No - Cancel]

 check_available --> LockTrays : [Yes]
 check_available --> CartError : [No]
 CartError --> ReviewCart : Keep cart unchanged

 LockTrays --> CalculateTotal : Lock trays & calculate subtotal
 CalculateTotal --> CreateOrder : Create order (AWAITING_PAYMENT)
 CreateOrder --> check_risk : Risk accepted & not expired?

 check_risk --> CreatePayment : [Yes]
 check_risk --> PaymentError : [No]

 CreatePayment --> PayRequest : Return QR code

 VerifyWebhook --> check_webhook : Valid webhook & payment?
 check_webhook --> ConfirmOrder : [Yes]
 check_webhook --> PaymentError : [No]
 PaymentError --> PayRequest : Retry payment

 ConfirmOrder --> check_planting_due : Planting date reached?
 check_planting_due --> SetPlanted : [Yes]
 check_planting_due --> SetWaiting : [No]

 SetPlanted --> SystemEnd
 SetWaiting --> SystemEnd
 SystemEnd --> [*]
 }

 state \"Payment Gateway (SePay)\" as Gateway {
 Transfer --> ProcessBank : Process transaction
 ProcessBank --> SendWebhook : Send HTTP Webhook
 SendWebhook --> VerifyWebhook
 }",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
